graduation_clearance.ceb: Mag-file unta ko sa akong graduation clearance.
graduation_clearance.en: I'd like to file my graduation clearance.

graduation_clearance.ceb: Graduating na ko! Kompleto na ni akong papeles, sigurado ko.
graduation_clearance.en: I'm graduating! My papers are complete, I'm sure.

graduation_clearance.ceb: Palihug, ipa-check nako akong checklist para sa graduation.
Last requirement na ni nako, ma'am. Ayaw na palihug ko pabalika.
graduation_clearance.en: This is my last requirement. Please don't send me back.

graduation_clearance.ceb: Gipaadto ko diri sa akong adviser para sa clearance.
graduation_clearance.en: My adviser sent me here for my clearance.

enroll_subject.ceb: Gi-enroll na nako ang {course} sa ISMIS, pero 'For Registrar approval' pa daw.
enroll_subject.en: I enrolled in {course} on ISMIS, but it still says 'For Registrar approval'.

enroll_subject.ceb: Mao ni akong form para sa {course}, section {section}. Pa-approve lang.
enroll_subject.en: Here's my form for {course}, section {section}. It just needs your approval.

enroll_subject.ceb: Ingon sa ISMIS kinahanglan pa daw ni i-approve sa Registrar.
enroll_subject.en: ISMIS says the Registrar still has to approve this.

enroll_subject.ceb: Section {section} sa {course} akong napili sa ISMIS. Okay na ba?
enroll_subject.en: I picked section {section} of {course} on ISMIS. Is it okay now?

enroll_subject.ceb: Pending pa akong {course} sa ISMIS. Palihug, i-approve na.
enroll_subject.en: My {course} is still pending on ISMIS. Please approve it.

enrollment_payment.ceb: Nag-enroll na ko sa ISMIS. Bayad na ko, ha. Pa-approve lang.
enrollment_payment.en: I enrolled on ISMIS. I've already paid, okay? It just needs approval.

enrollment_payment.ceb: Ania akong assessment. 'For validation' pa man daw sa ISMIS.
enrollment_payment.en: Here's my assessment. ISMIS still says 'for validation'.

enrollment_payment.ceb: Nibayad na akong mama gahapon, sigurado ko.
enrollment_payment.en: My mom paid yesterday, I'm sure.

enrollment_payment.ceb: Pending pa akong enrollment sa ISMIS. Ania ang akong slip.
enrollment_payment.en: My enrollment is still pending on ISMIS. Here's my slip.

first_year.ceb: Bag-o pa ko diri. Ingon sa Admissions diri daw ko moadto para sa akong ISMIS account.
first_year.en: I'm new here. Admissions told me to come here for my ISMIS account.

first_year.ceb: Freshman ko. Ania akong mga papeles para sa ISMIS.
first_year.en: I'm a freshman. Here are my papers for ISMIS.

first_year.ceb: Unang adlaw nako sa USC. Unsa may buhaton nako?
first_year.en: It's my first day at USC. What do I do?

first_year.ceb: Gisugo ko sa guard nga diri daw ko moadto.
first_year.en: The guard told me to come here.

add_subject.ceb: Mag-add unta ko og {course}. Pirmado na ni Sir.
add_subject.en: I'd like to add {course}. Sir already signed it.

add_subject.ceb: Kulang pa akong units. Pwede i-add ang {course}?
add_subject.en: I'm short on units. Can you add {course}?

add_subject.ceb: Gi-advise ko nga mag-add og {course}. Ania ang slip.
add_subject.en: I was advised to add {course}. Here's the slip.

add_subject.ceb: Dali ra ni, i-add lang ang {course}.

lines.ceb: Nagkurog akong kamot, basin naay kulang sa akong papeles...
lines.en: My hands are shaking, I hope nothing's missing from my papers...

lines.ceb: Hala, ako na diay sunod? Palihug ayaw ko kasab-i kon naay sayop.
lines.en: Oh, it's my turn already? Please don't scold me if something's wrong.

lines.ceb: Kompleto na ni tanan, 100 percent sure! Stamp na lang kulang.
lines.en: Everything here is complete, 100 percent sure! Just needs a stamp.

lines.ceb: Gi-triple check na nako ni ganinang buntag. Dali ra kaayo ni.
lines.en: I triple-checked this all morning. This'll take five seconds.

lines.ceb: ganina ra ko nagbarog diri. Pwede paspasan gamay?
lines.en: I've been standing here forever. Can we speed this up a bit?

lines.ceb: Nganong daghan man kaayog proseso? I-approve na lang gud na.
lines.en: Why is there so much red tape? Just approve it already.

lines.ceb: Mas lisod pa man ang mag-enroll kaysa finals exam namo!
lines.en: Enrolling is way harder than our actual final exams!

lines.ceb: Kon ma-enroll ko karon, mag-novena gyud ko sa Sto. Niño!
lines.en: If I get enrolled today, I swear I'm praying a novena!

lines.ceb: Hala, Window 3 diay ni? Nagtuo ko nga pila ni sa canteen!
lines.en: Wait, this is Window 3? I thought this was the canteen line!

lines.ceb: Sakto ba ning akong gipilahan nga window? Gisunod ra nako ang tawo sa atubangan.
lines.en: Am I even in the right window line? I just followed the person ahead of me.

lines.ceb: Maayong buntag! Kumusta inyong shift, dili ra kaayo kapoy?
lines.en: Good morning! How's your shift going, not too exhausting?

lines.ceb: Salamat daan sa tabang ha, kabalo ko daghan kaayo mog gi-atiman karon.
lines.en: Thanks in advance for the help, I know you're swamped today.

lines.ceb: Tabang! Mahutdan na ko og slot kon dili pa ni ma-process karon!
lines.en: Help! I'm going to run out of slots if this isn't processed right now!

lines.ceb: Hapit na mag-cutoff akong scholarship! Palihug tabangi ko!
lines.en: My scholarship cutoff is almost here! Please help me out!

lines.ceb: Naa koy original, photocopy, ug backup folder kon kinahanglan nimo!
lines.en: I have the original, a photocopy, and a backup folder if you need it!

lines.ceb: Gi-butangan na nako og sticky notes tanan nakong forms para dali ra nimo makita.
lines.en: I put sticky notes on all my forms so you can check them faster.

worried.ceb: Naay pula nga error sa ISMIS ganina. Okay ra ba akong enrollment?
worried.en: ISMIS showed a red error earlier. Is my enrollment okay?

worried.ceb: Kulbaan ko. Basin naay sayop sa akong papeles?
worried.en: I'm nervous. Is something wrong with my papers?

worried.ceb: Ingon akong classmate na-drop daw siya. Basin ako pud?
worried.en: My classmate said they got dropped. Am I dropped too?

worried.ceb: Wala ko kasabot sa ISMIS. Palihug ko i-check.
worried.en: I don't understand ISMIS. Please check it for me.

fine.ceb: Okay ra tanan. Salamat sa kakugi.
fine.en: All good. Thanks for the hard work.

fine.ceb: Hapsay imong agi karon. Bilib ko.
fine.en: Your work is sharp today. Color me impressed.

wrong.ceb: Naay sayop diri. Pag-amping na ugma.
wrong.en: There's a mistake here. Be more careful tomorrow.

wrong.ceb: Dili ni sakto. Basaha balik ang rulebook, ha?
wrong.en: This isn't right. Read the rulebook again, okay?

wrong.ceb: Nagdali ra kaayo ka ani nga papel. Tan-awa ang ISMIS sa sunod.
wrong.en: You rushed this paper. Check ISMIS closely next time.

bent.ceb: Kinsa man ni ang gipalusot nimo? Dili ni pwede.
bent.en: Who's this you let slip through? That's not allowed.

bent.ceb: Nakita nako ang pabor. Dili ta ingon ana diri.
bent.en: I saw the favor. That's not how we do things here.

bent.ceb: Bisag kaila pa na sa Dean o nagdala og siopao, walay palusot sa Window 3.
bent.en: Even if they know the Dean or brought siopao, no favors at Window 3.

mid_praise.ceb: Lorna: “Hapsay imong agi kang #{number}. Walay sipyat—padayon.”
mid_praise.en: Ma'am Lorna checked #{number}: Clean work. Accurate and steady—keep it up.

mid_praise.ceb: Lorna: “Sakto tanan imong gi-stamp karon. Mao nay akong gusto.”
mid_praise.en: Ma'am Lorna checked #{number}: Every stamp on the mark so far. Good job.

mid_warn.ceb: Lorna: “Nagtan-aw ko sa imong stamp kang #{number}, ha. Walay palusot diri.”
mid_warn.en: Ma'am Lorna inspected #{number}: I saw that favor. Don't bend the rules at my window.

mid_warn.ceb: Lorna: “Ayaw sige og flag kon sakto ra ang papel—malangan ang pila.”
mid_warn.en: Ma'am Lorna warned you: Stop flagging matching or harmless fields—false alarms drain the line's patience.

rule_reminders.missing_requirement: Lorna's spot check on #{number}: “Remember—graduating students need all 4 clearance items attached. Return with the exact missing list.”
rule_reminders.closed_section: Lorna's spot check on #{number}: “Remember—when a section is FULL on the Schedule tab, use 2 (Fix) to move them to an open, non-clashing section.”
rule_reminders.unpaid_balance: Lorna's spot check on #{number}: “Remember—any unpaid balance in ISMIS goes to the Cashier (3 Route) before we can approve.”
rule_reminders.ismis_login: Lorna's spot check on #{number}: “Remember—when a freshman's ISMIS account is Locked and their birthday matches, reset it at the window (2 Fix).”
rule_reminders.identity_mismatch: Lorna's spot check on #{number}: “Careful! That admission slip's birthday didn't match ISMIS. Never reset an account for the wrong person!”
rule_reminders.failed_prereq: Lorna's spot check on #{number}: “You missed the Grades tab—a 5.0 in the prerequisite means they cannot take the subject (5 Turn away).”
rule_reminders.inc_prereq: Lorna's spot check on #{number}: “Check the Grades tab—an INC in the prerequisite needs the adviser's note from Consultation (3 Route).”
rule_reminders.missing_signature: Lorna's spot check on #{number}: “Adding a subject requires an adviser's signature on the slip. Send unsigned slips to Consultation (or Hold if on break).”
rule_reminders.fake_signature: Lorna's spot check on #{number}: “Compare the signature against the Advisers tab specimen! Forged signatures must be rejected.”
rule_reminders.overload: Lorna's spot check on #{number}: “Over 24 units is an overload. Route them to the Dean's Office (or turn away if the Dean is closed for the day).”
rule_reminders.office_closed: Lorna's spot check on #{number}: “Watch the office clock! Never route a student to an office that is closed or on break.”
rule_reminders.clean: Lorna's spot check on #{number}: “Nothing was wrong with #{number}'s papers—don't turn away or route a clean application!”

lorna_takes_over.ceb: Okay, ako na ani. Pahuway sa, ha? Mag-istorya ta unya.
lorna_takes_over.en: Okay, I'll take it from here. Take a break, okay? We'll talk later.

failure_tips: Tip: call priority students early, and use Hold when an office is on break.
Tip: you don't have to flag everything. Flag what looks wrong, then decide.
Tip: a long line drains patience faster. Quick, correct calls win it back.

no_id.ceb: Nawala akong ID. Ang akong number kay {id}.
no_id.en: I lost my ID. My number is {id}.

no_id.ceb: Nabilin nako akong ID sa boarding house. {id} akong ID number.
no_id.en: I left my ID at the boarding house. My ID number is {id}.

cashier.ceb: Bayad na ko sa Cashier. Ania ang resibo.
cashier.en: I've paid at the Cashier. Here's the receipt.

cashier.ceb: Taas kaayo ang pila, pero bayad na ko!
cashier.en: The line was so long, but I've paid!

consultation.ceb: Napirmahan na ni Sir. Ania na.
consultation.en: Sir signed it now. Here you go.

consultation.ceb: Okay na daw sabi sa adviser. Ania iyang sulat.
consultation.en: The adviser says it's okay. Here's the note.

dean.ceb: Gi-approve na sa Dean ang akong overload.
Ok na sa Dean. Ania iyang pirma.
dean.en: The Dean is okay with it. Here's the signature.

cashier.ceb: Ingon sa Cashier wala man koy utang! Nganong didto ko nimo gipaadto?
cashier.en: The Cashier said I don't owe anything! Why did you send me there?

cashier.ceb: Wala man koy balance sa Cashier! Nausik akong oras.
cashier.en: I don't have a balance at the Cashier! I wasted my time.

consultation.ceb: Ingon sa adviser dili daw na iyaha. Nausik akong oras.
consultation.en: The adviser said that's not their job. I wasted my time.

consultation.ceb: Wala man daw problema sabi sa adviser. Nganong didto ko?
consultation.en: The adviser says there's no problem. Why was I sent there?

dean.ceb: Wala daw labot ang Dean ana. Mibalik ko diri.
dean.en: The Dean's office said it's not their concern. So I'm back.

dean.ceb: Gibalik ko sa Dean. Dili daw overload akong kaso.
dean.en: The Dean sent me back. They said mine isn't an overload.

closed.ceb: Sirado man ang opisina! Naghulat lang ko didto.
closed.en: The office was closed! I just stood there waiting.

closed.ceb: Break pa man sila! Nganong gipaadto ko nimo?
closed.en: They were still on break! Why did you send me?

ismis_login.ceb: Dili ko maka-login sa ISMIS. Unsaon man ni?
ismis_login.en: I can't log in to ISMIS. What do I do?

ismis_login.ceb: Locked daw akong account. Tabang, palihug.
ismis_login.en: It says my account is locked. Help, please.

ismis_login.ceb: Nakalimtan nako akong password, unya na-lock na hinoon.
ismis_login.en: I forgot my password, and now it's locked.

ismis_login.ceb: Ate, dili ko maka-login sa ISMIS. Unsa man akong password?
ismis_login.en: I can't log in to ISMIS. What's my password?

rejected_right.en: Okay, I'll go get it first.

rejected_right.ceb: Ay, sayang. Ugma na lang ko.
rejected_right.en: Aw, too bad. I'll come back tomorrow.

routed.ceb: Asa man na dapit? Ah, sige.

held.en: Okay, I'll wait on the bench.

held.ceb: Ok ra, lingkod sa ko didto.
held.en: That's fine, I'll sit over there.
I'll wait for it to open.

fixed.ceb: Wow, ok na diay. Salamat kaayo!
fixed.en: Wow, it's fixed. Thank you so much!

wrong.ceb: Ngano man? Sakto man akong papeles!
Unsa may sayop? Wala man koy problema.
wrong.en: What's wrong? I don't have a problem.

returned_angry.ceb: Mibalik ko kay sayop imong gisulti!
returned_angry.en: I'm back because you told me wrong!

returned_angry.ceb: Nag-usik ko og oras tungod nimo.
returned_angry.en: I wasted my time because of you.

returned_angry.ceb: Ikaduha na ni nga balik nako!
returned_angry.en: This is my second time back!

returned_angry.ceb: Pila pa man ka balik ani?
returned_angry.en: How many more times do I have to come back?

returned.ceb: Ok na, nahuman na nako didto.

requirement.ceb: Ay, nakalimtan nako ang {item}. Sorry kaayo.
requirement.en: Oh, I forgot the {item}. I'm so sorry.

requirement.ceb: Wala pa diay ko kakuha sa {item}...

requirement.en: I'll come back with the {item}, promise.

signature_blank.en: Sir hasn't signed it yet. I'll go back to him.

signature_blank.ceb: Busy man gud si Sir ganina. Wala pa niya napirmahan.
signature_blank.en: Sir was busy earlier. He hasn't signed it yet.

signature_fake.ceb: Ako ra ang nagpirma, wala man gud si Sir...
signature_fake.en: I signed it myself, Sir wasn't around...

signature_fake.ceb: Gipirmahan lang sa akong classmate. Ayaw lang ingna si Sir.
signature_fake.en: My classmate signed it. Please don't tell Sir.

balance.ceb: Ay, wala pa diay nako nabayran ang tanan.
balance.en: Oh, I haven't paid all of it yet.

balance.ceb: Sa sunod semana pa unta mobayad akong papa.
balance.en: My dad was going to pay next week.

birthday.ceb: Ah... dili diay ni akoa. Gipangayo ra sa akong ig-agaw.
birthday.en: Ah... it's not actually mine. My cousin asked me to do it.

birthday.ceb: Para ra ni sa akong amiga. Wala man siya kaanhi.
birthday.en: This is just for my friend. She couldn't come.

harmless_name.ceb: Gipamubo ra na nako akong pangalan. Ako ra gyud na.
harmless_name.en: I just shortened my name. That's really me.

harmless_name.ceb: Mao ra gihapon na nga pangalan, initial ra.
harmless_name.en: It's the same name, just the initial.

harmless_program.ceb: Pareho ra man na nga course, gisulat lang lahi.
harmless_program.en: That's the same course, just written differently.

harmless_program.ceb: BS IT ug BSIT, pareha ra man na.
harmless_program.en: BS IT and BSIT are the same thing.

same.ceb: Pareho ra man na, di ba?
